documents.title: Meridian Health Systems Investment Committee Memorandum

evidence.heading: Investment thesis
evidence.text: Meridian provides hospital workflow and clinical-operations software to health systems. The underwriting thesis centers on durable demand for software that coordinates complex hospital operations.

evidence.heading: Commercial diligence
evidence.text: Commercial diligence identified St. Anne Health Network and Atlantic University Hospitals as established customer relationships, with St. Anne representing the larger account.

documents.title: Meridian Health Systems Q2 2026 Management Report

evidence.heading: Financial performance
evidence.text: Revenue increased from $82 million in 2025Q2 to $98 million in 2026Q2. EBITDA in the current quarter was $20 million. Net retention in 2026Q2 was 111 percent.

evidence.heading: Operating indicator
evidence.text: The operating indicator 'implementation backlog sites' moved from 53 sites in 2025Q2 to 76 sites in 2026Q2.

evidence.heading: Management signal
evidence.text: Revenue continues to expand, but reliance on one health-system account remains a material commercial exposure.

documents.title: Meridian Health Systems Q2 2026 Board Update

evidence.heading: Primary board issue
evidence.text: The company's strongest operating trend is continued growth, while single-account exposure remains its clearest commercial vulnerability.

evidence.heading: Quarter-end scorecard
evidence.text: The Q2 scorecard records $98 million of revenue and 76 sites for implementation backlog sites.

documents.title: Meridian Health Systems Q2 2026 Risk Review

evidence.heading: Primary risk
evidence.text: St. Anne Health Network represents 31 percent of Meridian revenue, creating material customer concentration exposure.

evidence.heading: Risk context
evidence.text: Atlantic University Hospitals represents an additional 14 percent of revenue, making the two named health-system relationships important to the company's commercial profile.

evidence.heading: Operating indicator
evidence.text: For monitoring context, implementation backlog sites was 53 sites in 2025Q2 and 76 sites in 2026Q2.

evidence.heading: Investment thesis
evidence.text: Alder manufactures precision industrial components with meaningful exposure to aerospace demand. The investment thesis depends on durable customer relationships and specialized production capability.

evidence.heading: Commercial diligence
evidence.text: Skyward Aerospace and Kestrel Industrial Group were established customers during underwriting, giving Alder exposure to both aerospace and broader industrial end markets.

evidence.heading: Financial performance
evidence.text: Revenue increased from $100 million in 2025Q2 to $106 million in 2026Q2. EBITDA in the current quarter was $16 million.

evidence.heading: Operating indicator
evidence.text: The operating indicator 'production yield pct' moved from 96.8 percent in 2025Q2 to 94.2 percent in 2026Q2.

evidence.heading: Management signal
evidence.text: Manufacturing performance has weakened while a key aerospace material still lacks a qualified alternative source.

evidence.heading: Primary board issue
evidence.text: Two operating concerns are moving in the wrong direction at the same time: factory yield has deteriorated and a critical input remains dependent on one supplier.

evidence.heading: Quarter-end scorecard
evidence.text: The Q2 scorecard records $106 million of revenue and 94.2 percent for production yield pct.

evidence.heading: Primary risk
evidence.text: TitaniumWorks GmbH is Alder's only qualified source for a critical aerospace titanium input. The German supplier accounts for 28 percent of supplier exposure represented by the relationship.

evidence.heading: Risk context
evidence.text: Alder also sources semiconductor components from SecureChip Technologies, but that relationship is classified as medium criticality rather than critical.

evidence.heading: Operating indicator
evidence.text: For monitoring context, production yield pct was 96.8 percent in 2025Q2 and 94.2 percent in 2026Q2.

evidence.heading: Investment thesis
evidence.text: BluePeak provides freight-management and routing software for logistics customers. The thesis combines workflow software adoption with growing complexity in cross-border freight operations.

evidence.heading: Commercial diligence
evidence.text: MapleMart Canada and TransContinental Freight were established Canadian customer relationships before Northstar's investment.

evidence.heading: Financial performance
evidence.text: Revenue increased from $66 million in 2025Q2 to $72 million in 2026Q2. EBITDA in the current quarter was $13 million. Net retention in 2026Q2 was 101 percent.

evidence.heading: Operating indicator
evidence.text: The operating indicator 'freight volume million shipments' moved from 13.3 million_shipments in 2025Q2 to 12.7 million_shipments in 2026Q2.

evidence.heading: Management signal
evidence.text: Several customers have reduced shipment expectations as activity softened across selected Canadian freight corridors.

evidence.heading: Primary board issue
evidence.text: The main operating concern is a loss of freight momentum in Canada rather than a broad contraction in the customer base.

evidence.heading: Quarter-end scorecard
evidence.text: The Q2 scorecard records $72 million of revenue and 12.7 million_shipments for freight volume million shipments.

evidence.heading: Primary risk
evidence.text: Customer shipment forecasts have weakened in selected Canadian corridors, creating demand sensitivity for BluePeak.

evidence.heading: Risk context
evidence.text: Canada represents 36 percent of BluePeak revenue exposure, while MapleMart Canada and TransContinental Freight are two named customer relationships in that market.

evidence.heading: Operating indicator
evidence.text: For monitoring context, freight volume million shipments was 13.3 million_shipments in 2025Q2 and 12.7 million_shipments in 2026Q2.

evidence.heading: Investment thesis
evidence.text: HelioGrid develops distributed solar and battery infrastructure. The underwriting thesis is based on continued deployment of distributed energy assets and expansion of installed capacity.

evidence.heading: Commercial diligence
evidence.text: Northbridge Utilities was an established customer relationship before Northstar's investment and provided evidence of demand from utility counterparties.

evidence.heading: Financial performance
evidence.text: Revenue increased from $68 million in 2025Q2 to $92 million in 2026Q2. EBITDA in the current quarter was $18 million.

evidence.heading: Operating indicator
evidence.text: The operating indicator 'installed capacity mw' moved from 530 megawatts in 2025Q2 to 770 megawatts in 2026Q2.

evidence.heading: Management signal
evidence.text: Growth remains strong, but several western storage projects are progressing more slowly because local approvals are taking longer than planned.

evidence.heading: Primary board issue
evidence.text: Rapid scale expansion and permitting friction are occurring simultaneously: installed capacity is rising while some projects remain behind their original schedules.

evidence.heading: Quarter-end scorecard
evidence.text: The Q2 scorecard records $92 million of revenue and 770 megawatts for installed capacity mw.

evidence.heading: Primary risk
evidence.text: Permitting delays are affecting the schedule of several distributed storage projects in western states.

evidence.heading: Risk context
evidence.text: HelioGrid depends on Pacific Battery Cells for battery cells and SolarCore Modules for solar modules, creating additional supply-chain exposures around its deployment program.

evidence.heading: Operating indicator
evidence.text: For monitoring context, installed capacity mw was 530 megawatts in 2025Q2 and 770 megawatts in 2026Q2.

documents.title: Vantage Retail Analytics Investment Committee Memorandum

evidence.heading: Investment thesis
evidence.text: Vantage provides demand-forecasting and merchandising analytics for large retailers. The investment thesis is based on increasing adoption of data-driven merchandising workflows.

evidence.heading: Commercial diligence
evidence.text: Crown Street Retail and Hartwell Department Stores were established customers before Northstar's investment and represented meaningful enterprise-retail relationships.

documents.title: Vantage Retail Analytics Q2 2026 Management Report

evidence.heading: Financial performance
evidence.text: Revenue increased from $60 million in 2025Q2 to $79 million in 2026Q2. EBITDA in the current quarter was $17 million. Net retention in 2026Q2 was 97 percent.

evidence.heading: Operating indicator
evidence.text: The operating indicator 'forecast jobs million' moved from 59 million_jobs in 2025Q2 to 93 million_jobs in 2026Q2.

evidence.heading: Management signal
evidence.text: New-logo activity remains healthy, but newer customer cohorts are taking longer to settle into normal renewal behavior.

documents.title: Vantage Retail Analytics Q2 2026 Board Update

evidence.heading: Primary board issue
evidence.text: Top-line expansion remains strong even though the quality of newer customer cohorts has weakened.

evidence.heading: Quarter-end scorecard
evidence.text: The Q2 scorecard records $79 million of revenue and 93 million_jobs for forecast jobs million.

documents.title: Vantage Retail Analytics Q2 2026 Risk Review

evidence.heading: Primary risk
evidence.text: Vantage's net retention declined from 112 percent in 2025 Q2 to 97 percent in 2026 Q2 despite continued revenue growth.

evidence.heading: Risk context
evidence.text: Crown Street Retail represents 27 percent of company revenue and is currently classified as an at-risk customer relationship.

evidence.heading: Operating indicator
evidence.text: For monitoring context, forecast jobs million was 59 million_jobs in 2025Q2 and 93 million_jobs in 2026Q2.

evidence.heading: Investment thesis
evidence.text: Orbis provides enterprise identity and threat-detection software. The investment thesis is based on durable cybersecurity demand and expansion of recurring enterprise deployments.

evidence.heading: Commercial diligence
evidence.text: Rheinwerk AG was an established enterprise customer before Northstar's investment, providing direct exposure to the German market.

evidence.heading: Financial performance
evidence.text: Revenue increased from $97 million in 2025Q2 to $121 million in 2026Q2. EBITDA in the current quarter was $30 million. Net retention in 2026Q2 was 117 percent.

evidence.heading: Operating indicator
evidence.text: The operating indicator 'platform uptime pct' moved from 99.99 percent in 2025Q2 to 99.97 percent in 2026Q2.

evidence.heading: Management signal
evidence.text: Authentication reliability deteriorated during the first quarter before service performance recovered during Q2.

evidence.heading: Primary board issue
evidence.text: The authentication reliability problem has been remediated, and service availability recovered materially in the following quarter.

evidence.heading: Quarter-end scorecard
evidence.text: The Q2 scorecard records $121 million of revenue and 99.97 percent for platform uptime pct.

evidence.heading: Primary risk
evidence.text: The ORBIS-IDX-7 service experienced an authentication defect that caused intermittent identity-validation failures for a subset of enterprise tenants.

evidence.heading: Risk context
evidence.text: Germany represents 28 percent of Orbis revenue exposure, and Rheinwerk AG is a named German customer. This is a commercial exposure rather than a critical-supplier dependency.

evidence.heading: Operating indicator
evidence.text: For monitoring context, platform uptime pct was 99.99 percent in 2025Q2 and 99.97 percent in 2026Q2.

evidence.heading: Commercial diligence

evidence.heading: Investment thesis
evidence.text: NovaBio develops laboratory automation and diagnostic instrumentation. The investment thesis combines automation demand with recurring needs for high-precision life-sciences equipment.

evidence.heading: Commercial diligence
evidence.text: Alpine Diagnostics and Genomicore Laboratories were established life-sciences customers before Northstar's investment.

evidence.heading: Financial performance
evidence.text: Revenue increased from $67 million in 2025Q2 to $83 million in 2026Q2. EBITDA in the current quarter was $14 million.

evidence.heading: Operating indicator
evidence.text: The operating indicator 'instrument shipments' moved from 950 units in 2025Q2 to 1175 units in 2026Q2.

evidence.heading: Management signal
evidence.text: Shipment growth remains healthy, but a precision-motion assembly still depends on a single qualified source.

evidence.heading: Primary board issue
evidence.text: Commercial activity continues to expand while an unresolved single-source dependency remains embedded in the automation platform.

evidence.heading: Quarter-end scorecard
evidence.text: The Q2 scorecard records $83 million of revenue and 1175 units for instrument shipments.

evidence.heading: Primary risk
evidence.text: Helix Motion GmbH is the only currently qualified supplier for a precision motion assembly used in NovaBio's automation platform. The supplier is located in Germany.

evidence.heading: Risk context
evidence.text: NovaBio also sources laboratory optics from Alpine Optics AG in Switzerland, but that relationship is classified as high criticality rather than single-source critical.

evidence.heading: Operating indicator
evidence.text: For monitoring context, instrument shipments was 950 units in 2025Q2 and 1175 units in 2026Q2.
